text:
maria: Kicking off a quick acceptance check for the SPARC1 GPU cluster provision. Goal: validate capacity, networking, SLO gates, and handoff to oncall. Opening checklist below.

alex: Quick Q — how many GPUs total and what types? need to validate scheduling across AZs.

maria: 48x A100-sxm4 (12 nodes x 4 gpus). NVLink enabled on node type `c5-gpu-sx`.

pj: OK - add these checks: - scheduler pods pass node affinity; - NVLink correct; - driver and CUDA versions match golden image.

samir: Also note preemptible/spot fallback policy. For Dedicated customers, we must pin non-preemptible pool. Example config: `nodePool: {name: sparc1-np, preemptible: false}`

claire: Network: ensure control-plane egress to metrics and artifact stores. On the firewall rules we need ports 9090, 8080, 22 and 6000-6010 for NVLink mgmt.

alex: Can someone run the smoke script? `./scripts/infra/smoke_sparc1.sh` — it runs CUDA sanity, simple inference sampler, and tracer.

infra-ci-bot: smoke job queued: job id `ci-smoke-1714009876-1` — will post results.

maria: Paste expected pass criteria so owners can verify: 1) all K8s nodes Ready; 2) GPU driver + CUDA tested; 3) 99th perc latency <= 150ms on 256-token sample; 4) KV cache correctness; 5) no packet loss on inter-node test.

pj: For 3) add p95 and p99. p95 <= 80ms, p99 <= 150ms under minimal canary traffic (10 rps).

oncall-sre: We'll run synthetic canary after smoke. Need route53 healthcheck + alerting runbook linked.

claire: Routing policies: smart-routing must be disabled initially (we want deterministic routing). Put `smart_routing: false` in config.

samir: Cost control: enable per-customer tagging and set autoscale ceiling to 12 nodes to cap cost during initial validation.

infra-ci-bot: smoke job finished — summary: 12 nodes Ready, CUDA 12.3 installed, basic inference latency p95=72ms p99=142ms, small packet loss detected between node3<>node5 (0.3%). Full logs at https://ci.internal/jobs/ci-smoke-1714009876-1

alex: Re: packet loss — suspected MTU mismatch. Can someone run `iperf3 -c node5 -M 9000` on node3?

maria: @networking-team can you take node3/node5 MTU and check switch configs? tagging for network on-call.

claire: I'll open a ticket and attach capture. If MTU mismatch confirmed, we'll set MTU down to 9000 cluster-wide for now.

pj: Other items: SLO gates in monitoring: alerts to create — `gpu_node_down > 1 for 5m`, `inference_p99 > 200ms for 2m`, `nvlink_errors > 0`.

oncall-sre: I'll add alerts and a temporary escalation policy to the incident channel.

maria: Great. Final handoff plan: 1) fix network MTU; 2) re-run smoke -> pass; 3) canary 10rps for 1 hour; 4) hand to SRE for rotation. Owners: networking=claire, smoke runs=alex, alerts=oncall-sre, cost caps=samir. Any objections?

alex: :thumbsup: no objections.

samir: :+1: will set cost caps and tagging.

claire: On it, starting ticket now.

maria: infra-ci-bot, schedule re-smoke in 45min `ci-smoke-1714009876-2`

infra-ci-bot: scheduled job ci-smoke-1714009876-2 to run at +45m.

oncall-sre: pinging SRE rotation leads to be ready for handoff after canary.

maria: Thanks all. Putting this thread into the SPARC1 acceptance doc. Will update when re-smoke completes.
